Delivery.fulfilmentTitle: Collecting, or shall we bring it?
Delivery.fulfilmentLede: {clinic} has your order ready to price and fill. Tell them how you would like it.
Delivery.pricedByClinic: {clinic} sets these prices and receives the payment. Carevelo takes nothing from it.
Delivery.methodLegend: How would you like your medicines?
Delivery.pickupNote: Come to {clinic}'s pharmacy and collect it yourself. Bring something that identifies you.
Delivery.deliveryNote: A rider brings it to your address.
Delivery.deliveryNoteWithFee: A rider brings it to your address. {clinic} charges {fee} for this.
Delivery.deliveryNeedsConsent: You will be asked first whether your address and phone number may be given to the rider.
Delivery.riderKnowsNothing: A rider is told your name, your phone number and where to go. Never what is in the package, and never why it was prescribed.
Delivery.chosenPickupBody: It will be waiting for you at {clinic}'s pharmacy. Bring something that identifies you.
Delivery.chosenDeliveryBody: {clinic} will send it out with a rider.
Delivery.notDecidedBody: {clinic} has not recorded how this order is being handed over. Ask at the pharmacy.
Delivery.controlledTitle: This one must be collected in person
Delivery.controlledBody: The order contains a controlled medicine. Ugandan law does not allow those to be delivered, and there is no exception — collect it at {clinic}'s pharmacy, in person, with identification.
Delivery.outOfAreaTitle: Delivery does not reach your address
Delivery.outOfAreaBody: {clinic} does not deliver to your area, so collection at the pharmacy is the way to get this order.
Delivery.onlyPickupOffered: Collection is the only option on this order.
Delivery.failedBody: Nothing has changed on your order. Try again in a moment, or ask {clinic} at the pharmacy.
Delivery.contentsNote: This page shows how far your package has got. It never lists what is inside it — and neither the rider nor this page is told.
Delivery.milestonesEmptyBody: As soon as {clinic} hands your package to a rider, each step appears here.
Delivery.failedDeliveryTitle: Your delivery could not be completed
Delivery.failedDeliveryBody: Your medicines are on their way back to {clinic}'s pharmacy, and nothing has been lost.
Delivery.rescheduleCall: Call {clinic} on {phone} to arrange another attempt, or to say you will collect it instead.
Delivery.rescheduleNoPhone: Contact {clinic} to arrange another attempt, or to say you will collect it instead.
Delivery.refundHonesty: If you have already paid and decide not to go ahead, the refund is {clinic}'s to make, through the same mobile money service you paid with. Carevelo never receives your money and cannot return it.
Delivery.refreshNote: This page checks for an update on its own while you are looking at it. You can also check now.
Delivery.unavailableTitle: The delivery could not be checked
Delivery.unreachable: We could not reach {clinic}'s system just now. Try again in a moment, or call the clinic.
